label: Node-to-node encryption
type: encryption of intra-cluster traffic between Couchbase Server nodes, as distinct from client-to-node traffic. Configurable in strict and control modes.
note: Promoted as a wire setting orthogonal to tls:mutual-tls - see that record. Its strict mode is the setting that makes the cleartext ports unavailable, which is what gives port:18091 a reason to exist as a registry term.
